installer.title: SMLIGHT Bluetooth proxy
installer.description: Use the Bluetooth of SMLIGHT SLZB gateways (SLZB-OS) as additional receiver for the Bluetooth modules
installer.name: slzb_bt_proxy

params.label: Host
params.help: Hostname or IP of the SLZB gateway, enable the BLE proxy in its web interface (Bluetooth)
